newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria's Randa voted CA sup board chief.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria's Randa voted CA sup board chief.

text.p: Creditanstalt-Bankverein's supervisory board on Friday voted Bank Austria chief executive Gerhard Randa as its new chairman, a Creditanstalt spokesman said.

The vote came shortly after the bank's extraordinary shareholders meeting voted Randa and two other board members of Bank Austria, Karl Samstag and Friedrich Kadrnoska, onto the non-executive supervisory board with more than 99 percent of votes.
Randa, 52, replaces Walter Fremuth, who has headed the supervisory board since 1993.

"I can assure you that I will use all my experience, all my power and all my abilities for the benefit of this institution, in the interest of its customers, all staff, and particularly that of the shareholders," Randa told shareholders.
Eight other candidates presented by Bank Austria for the 21-member council were also voted in with majorities of more than 90 percent.

Bank Austria bought the Austrian government's 69.45 percent voting stake in Creditanstalt in January for 17.2 billion schillings in cash, closing the book on Europe's longest running privatisation saga.
